correctness.rationale: All 255 anticanonical cubic masks are tested by an exact 15x18 Macaulay rank criterion, with independent chart Groebner smoothness checks. Exhaustive enumeration yields 60 smooth equations and 104 all-smooth pencils. Full eight-element automorphism action has thirteen free orbits. Every representative has an explicit triangular Groebner ideal with a squarefree degree-seven polynomial and irreducible factors recorded in verification_elimination.json. Bézout length nine plus two fixed plane rational points proves geometrically reduced residual length seven on the blowup, across all orbits. Independent F2^k counts for k<=7 verify Frobenius types and exact point spectra; the no-net bound is a direct differential-dimension argument. The claim does not infer an infinite property from finite testing.

value.rationale: The Frobenius splitting of a natural seven-point anticanonical pencil base scheme is intrinsic arithmetic intersection data, not a renamed count. The complete reducedness classification and its equivalence with observable genus-one member point-count multisets distinguish arithmetic configurations invisible to the previously tabulated rational basepoint totals; a prime-degree closed point stratum (7) is geometrically meaningful. The structural maximum-projective-dimension consequence places these configurations in the finite-field Bertini problem, while the numerical count and orbit list alone are not advanced as value.
